audit.why: Lane difficulty 7.5/10 with a 57.94% win rate over 321 games is consistent: Heimerdinger's nest dominates the level 2-6 window, Wukong's threat is the level 6 Cyclone engage and the 2+ item armour/Black Cleaver window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart claimed Heimerdinger owns the 2+ item stage while whys[6], spikes[3] and breakdown.late all say Wukong out-scales him there. Level 2 was marked 'Skill' although whys[1]/spikes[0] describe a clear Heimerdinger stage, and Level 6 was marked a Wukong win although whys[4] calls it a coinflip. The packet levelChart agrees with the prose on all three rows.
audit.why: Both layers of the chart must agree with each other and with the written spike text, otherwise the page answers 'who wins this level' two different ways.
audit.corrected: Level 2 -> Heimerdinger, Level 6 -> Skill, 2+ items -> Wukong, with matching ratings and whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crushing Blow (Q) is an auto-attack reset and that tell is never stated — the page tells you to fear 'Q shred' without saying the wind-up is the cue. spikes[1] also wrote 'Nimbus Strikes' as a verb; the ability is Nimbus Strike (E), and Warrior Trickster (W) is the clone.
audit.why: Riot's names for Wukong are Stone Skin (P), Crushing Blow (Q), Warrior Trickster (W), Nimbus Strike (E), Cyclone (R). The missing-interactions entry flags the auto-reset tell as applicable and absent. Heimerdinger's CH-3X (E) has an 11s flat cooldown and 970 range and is the only lockdown he owns, so spending it on the decoy is the losing line.
audit.corrected: Name Nimbus Strike (E) and Warrior Trickster (W) explicitly, and state that Crushing Blow (Q) resets his auto — react to the wind-up, not the cast.

audit.why: CH-3X on a flat 11s cooldown is the punishable window on Heimerdinger's side; the text already tells you to hold it for his engage rather than poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: The auto-reset tell on Crushing Blow was absent from every writable field.
audit.why: It changes the reaction window: the damage is already committed once the animation starts.

edits.after: Your second and third turrets land — overlapping slow-beams make any Nimbus Strike (E) dash into the nest a damage sink.

edits.after: Upgraded E deletes his all-in, but Cyclone knocks up over your turrets onto an immobile yordle — hold the grenade for HIS engage.

edits.before: Full three-turret nest plus CH-3X online: when he Nimbus Strikes in, land the grenade's center on the REAL Wukong (not the W clone) to stun him under all three beams and the trade is suicide for him.
edits.after: Full three-turret nest plus CH-3X online: when he dashes in with Nimbus Strike (E), land the grenade's center on the REAL Wukong, not the Warrior Trickster clone, and all three beams plus an 11s stun bury the trade.
